other_subtypes.Review: Required evidence is missing, unresolved, or fails a shared admission check.
other_subtypes.Sequence: Nested protein without independent support or >=95% Unsafe 9-mer containment.
other_subtypes.Expression: Neither positive expression route qualifies, or the target maximum or Disposable cap fails.

expression_bounds.target_maximum: max(tumor, adult reproductive, developmental) >= 1 and above every measured nonreproductive normal and Disposable value on the comparison scale.
expression_bounds.cap_scope: Each source scale separately; a screening convention, not a tolerance.

rare_cell_rna.unit: One adult donor x one named Vital or Protected cell population, UMI counts
rare_cell_rna.signal: >= 1% of a donor's cells and >= 10 cells carry >= 2 molecules.
rare_cell_rna.replication: The signal in >= 2 independent studies of the same organ, which agree on a cell type or include >= 3 donors. Donors of one study share its libraries and reference; one donor in each of two studies, in different cell types, agrees on nothing but the organ.
rare_cell_rna.single_study: Without replication, a signal counts only when >= 5% of a donor's cells carry multiple molecules.
rare_cell_rna.protected: Protected populations need 2 times these frequencies.
rare_cell_rna.single_molecules: Cells with one molecule never change a category. A mis-assigned read from a paralog, pseudogene or overlapping gene produces exactly this pattern.
rare_cell_rna.mapping_risk: Shared transcript sequence with another locus, or an exon inside another same-strand gene. Counts for a flagged gene cannot be attributed to it.
rare_cell_rna.confirmation: Bulk RNA >= 1 native TPM in the same organ in both the HPA and GTEx sample sets, a different assay with its own read assignment.
rare_cell_rna.established: A replicated signal at a locus without mapping risk, or any signal with bulk confirmation. Unsafe.
rare_cell_rna.dismissed: A signal that is neither: counts at a flagged locus, or from one study, that no other assay confirms. Recorded with its reason; no category effect.
rare_cell_rna.literature: Where a reviewed publication reports the gene in the same organ by a gene-specific assay, 1% detection in one donor is established, single molecules included: two assay types then agree. Published protein in a Vital or Protected tissue excludes through the knowledge layer without any counts.

consequences.dismissed: No finding; the reason and counts stay in the record.
consequences.below_screen: No finding. Not a demonstration of absence or safety.
consequences.unassessed: Recorded as unmeasured; never treated as negative.

rare_cell_rna.interpretation: Detection frequency measures captured RNA, not the fraction of cells producing protein. No cutoff is a calibrated toxicity threshold.

cancer_rna.repeated_rule: T >= 1 AND T > N in at least two independent participants
cancer_rna.single_rule: T >= 10 * max(N, 1) in at least one qualified tumor sample
cancer_rna.normal_reference: Maximum QC-passing, identity-resolved measurement in the declared compatible normal panel, excluding specifically allowed Disposable and reproductive compartments.
cancer_rna.comparability: One documented comparison scale and complete required normal contexts. Equal unit names alone do not establish comparability. No TPM/nTPM/pTPM/CP10K pooling.
cancer_rna.alternative: Reviewed reliable tumor protein with exact identity and source scope.

reproductive_evidence.bulk: Mapped human reproductive compartment >=1 native TPM/nTPM.
reproductive_evidence.cell: Mapped reproductive cells >=1 native TPM/nTPM and >=20 reads.
reproductive_evidence.developmental: Human stage/lineage mean >=1 TPM, >=20 cells, >=5 cells at >=1 TPM, and >=10% cells at >=1 TPM. Retain embryos, donors and stage.
reproductive_evidence.protein: Reliable mapped reproductive IHC or reviewed human reproductive protein.
reproductive_evidence.concentration: Descriptive measurement; not an admission gate for either set.

shared_normal_policy.scope: Normal assessment only; legacy cancer, reproductive and concentration gates excluded.
shared_normal_policy.allowances: Same resolved reproductive and Disposable compartment allowances for both sets. Immune, endothelial and other protected cells do not inherit an organ's allowance.
shared_normal_policy.threshold_interpretation: RNA/IHC cutoffs are screening conventions, not measured injury thresholds. Negative IHC does not establish a calibrated safety margin.

translation: Qualifying coding reference or supported noncanonical ORF plus complete approved MANE-first/canonical representative; resolve conflicting coding evidence. Experimental protein detection is retained separately.
published_target_support: Positive evidence annotation for a curated, exact-scope target nomination. Preserve every protein-paper link and its attested claim; biology or background-table coverage alone is not a target nomination. Publication cannot override an exclusion or hold.
only_meaning: Membership in one qualified set, not proven absence from the other context.
